description: The file defines an immutable class `StopStreaming` that represents a control message to stop streaming of entities of a specified `StreamingType`. It includes fields for the streaming type and connection correlation ID, with appropriate constructors, getters, and overrides for `equals`, `hashCode`, and `toString` methods.

classes.name: StopStreaming
classes.description: Immutable message class indicating a request to stop streaming entities of a specified StreamingType associated with a particular connection.

methods.name: StopStreaming
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the streaming type and connection correlation ID, checking for null values.

methods.name: getStreamingType
methods.description: Returns the type of streaming that this message is instructing to stop.

methods.name: getConnectionCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID of the connection/session.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare StopStreaming instances based on streamingType and connectionCorrelationId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate a hash based on streamingType and connectionCorrelationId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the StopStreaming object.
